items.title: What's on This Page
items.why:
A real prize at Alice's finale, like Lennon's wish, in the Eras words. Every picture is a mock-up drawn inside the real app in her look. Nothing is built.

One thing to know: her bracelets are milestones, not workouts. The seventh is "100 days logged", so the earliest she can reach the finale is 100 days after she starts logging.

items.title: Prize and the In-App Wish
items.why: Today the finale offers three in-app wishes: a new theme, an eternal aura, or the Headliner title.

options.label: A prize, then a wish too
options.desc: She claims a real prize and still makes her in-app wish. The line reads "Then make a wish in the app."

options.label: A prize or a wish
options.desc: One choice from either list. The line reads "Or pick a wish in the app."

options.label: A prize instead of the wish
options.desc: The in-app wishes go away for Alice.

items.title: The Wording
items.why:
Heading: "Your tour sold out!"
Under it: "Pick your encore prize. A grown-up approved these."
Button: "Claim this prize"

After she claims it: "Your encore prize is a trip to the park. Show this to a grown-up."

items.title: Who Chooses the Prize
items.why: You asked for Alice to pick from a list a grown-up approves. Lennon's works differently: a grown-up picks the one prize.

options.label: A grown-up approves a list; Alice picks
options.desc: Same six prizes as Lennon's, plus one typed by a grown-up. At least one must be ticked.

options.label: A grown-up picks one, like Lennon

items.title: Which Passcode
items.why: Lennon's prize sits behind his profile's passcode, which only grown-ups know. Alice knows her own passcode, because it opens her app, so it can't keep her out of the prize list.

options.label: A separate grown-up passcode
options.desc: Six digits, on the same passcode screen. A grown-up sets it the first time they open Encore prizes in her Settings.

options.label: Her own passcode
options.desc: Simplest, but she could approve her own prizes.

items.title: Where Grown-Ups Approve It
items.why: A card in Alice's Settings, shown only on her profile. It asks for the passcode before it opens.

items.title: After the Encore
items.why: Lennon's Dragon Balls scatter after a wish. Alice's bracelets are one-time milestones, so they stay collected.

options.label: A new prize every 100 days logged
options.desc: After the first encore, each further 100 days logged earns another prize from the list.

items.title: Build 2.33.0?
items.why: After your picks I build it, run every check, and publish. Only Alice's profile changes. Kid mode (2.32.0) goes out first, once its tests finish.

options.label: Build and publish when checks pass
